artworks.title: Charles, Prince of Wales
artworks.description: There is a circular engraved portrait of a man from the chest upward, positioned in the center of a square piece of worn paper. The man faces slightly to his left with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a prominent nose, a slight smile, expressive eyes, and neatly combed hair styled backward. He wears an elaborate collar, likely made of lace, common in historical formal wear, that extends outward with a high neckline framing his neck. The portrait is bordered by inscribed text, set against a background patterned with fine lines and dots. The aged paper background is beige with visible age spots.

artworks.title: James I, King of England
artworks.description: This image is a circular portrait of a man. The man is facing forward and is positioned directly towards the viewer. He has a composed expression, with a short beard and mustache. His hair appears to be neatly styled under a wide-brimmed hat adorned with a jewel or badge. The man is dressed in ornate clothing featuring an elaborate ruffled collar typical of the period, along with a jacket embellished with buttons and intricate patterns. Around him is a circular border with text. The background inside the circle is plain, while the outer border contains decorative elements. The surrounding area outside the circular illustration is a simple, neutral space, without any additional design or imagery.

artworks.title: Charles, Prince of Wales
artworks.description: The image is a circular engraving featuring a bust portrait. The person is shown facing slightly to the right, with sharp facial features, prominent eyes, and wavy hair neatly styled. They are wearing an elaborate garment with a high collar. The background has a textured pattern, and there is an inscription along the circle's border. No jewelry or objects are visible. The image is set against a plain, slightly aged background typical of historical paper.

artworks.title: Charles, Prince of Wales
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed black and white circular engraving of a man's bust. The man is depicted from the shoulders up, with his body facing slightly to the side while his head is turned towards the viewer. He has a refined face with a thin mustache and a small beard. His hair is short to medium in length, styled upwards and back, revealing his forehead. The man wears an elaborate ruffled collar and richly textured clothing. The circle surrounding him contains intricate detailing and text. The background is plain, with the image centered on a cream-colored paper with a slightly rough texture.

artworks.title: Henrietta Maria
artworks.description: The image shows a small, circular portrait of a person that includes the head and the upper portion of the shoulders. The person's face is positioned forward in the center of the circle, with a soft expression, large eyes, a slightly open mouth, and voluminous, textured hair styled high and away from the face. The person wears a garment with visible detailing around the collar area and is adorned with a string of pearls around the neck. This circular portrait is enclosed by a text band that includes a name or inscription, partially readable. The background of the image is a plain, lightly textured beige surface with some faint markings midway down and near the bottom edge.

artworks.title: Henrietta Maria
artworks.description: This image features a circular portrait of a person from the shoulders up, placed at the center of the composition. The individual is positioned forward, facing the viewer, with a calm expression on their face. Their facial features are finely detailed, with arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, a delicate nose, and full lips. The hair is styled into a voluminous updo. They are adorned in clothing with a high, intricate lace collar, and perhaps a patterned fabric. The person wears a necklace and a single visible earring. Surrounding the portrait is a decorative circular frame with inscriptions. The background consists of the plain paper ground on which the portrait is printed, devoid of any other decorative element. Handwritten text is visible at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Charles I, King of England
artworks.description: The image shows a circular portrait of a man's upper body, captured from the chest upwards in a slightly three-quarter view. The man faces slightly to the left and has a long face with a short, well-groomed beard and mustache. He wears a sizable hat covering much of his head, with short hair around the edges. The man wears elaborate historical or noble clothing with a wide, detailed collar. The background is plain, and the circular frame has an inscription along the inside edge against a shaded pattern. The image is set against a textured paper background showing signs of age or wear.

artworks.title: Charles I and Henrietta Maria Facing to the Right [left half]
artworks.description: The image displays an engraved profile of a man's head and upper torso in the center of a circular design, possibly a coin or medallion. The man has distinctive facial features including a beard, mustache, and wavy hair styled back. He is depicted wearing period-specific clothing, likely a high-collared garment with decorative edges. The circle surrounding the figure has a textured background with a faint inscription or pattern along its edge. The background is plain, textured paper.

artworks.title: Charles I and Henrietta Maria Facing to the Left [right half]
artworks.description: The image displays two individuals' side profiles within a circular frame. The person in the foreground has distinct facial features, including a prominent nose, chin, and curly hair. Both figures wear historical clothing with intricate patterns. The background within the circle is devoid of other elements and is filled with fine lines or shading. The circular design is set on a plain, light-colored surface.

artworks.title: Three Crowns Supported by Two Sceptres [left half]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a circular emblem containing three crowns. The emblem displays a circular design featuring three ornate crowns arranged in a triangular formation, connected by light scepters. Each of the crowns is detailed with intricate line work, showcasing traditional regal symbols such as crosses and points. The background of the circle is filled with a series of diagonal hatch lines. The outer rim of the circle features an intricate pattern. The drawing is rendered in monochrome, primarily using shades of black against a light background.

artworks.title: Three Crowns Supported by Two Sceptres [right half]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three crowned symbols within a circular emblem. The image features three detailed crowns arranged in a triangular configuration. The crowns are depicted with ornate designs, enclosed within a circular border with text and additional decorative elements. The background has a textured finish.

artworks.title: Princess Elizabeth, Queen of Bohemia (?)
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders portrait of a person. The person is facing forward with a slight turn to the right, displaying finely detailed features and curly hair styled in an elaborate manner. The facial features include a serene expression with eyes that appear attentive and eyebrows that are delicately arched. Their attire is ornate, featuring a richly decorated garment with intricate patterns and a prominent lace collar or neck ruff that frames their face. Encircling the collar is a piece of jewelry, likely a necklace, which adds to the elaborate ensemble. The person appears to be set against a plain, textured background that highlights the detailed work on the attire.

artworks.title: George Villiers, 1st Duke of Buckingham
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person facing forward in a three-quarter view. The individual has a mustache, a pointed beard, and wavy hair. They wear clothing with a ruffled lace collar and buttons. The background is a dark oval shape.

artworks.title: Two Boats for "L'Abside de Notre-Dame de Paris"
artworks.description: The image shows a top-down view of two rowboats sketched onto a piece of paper. The drawing focuses on the boats without any distant landscape elements. The technique used is loose pencil strokes, creating a sketch-like appearance. The color palette is monochrome with gray paper serving as the backdrop to darker gray and black pencil strokes forming the boats. One boat is detailed with visible planks and seats, while a smaller boat is also depicted with simple strokes. Both boats are parallel to horizontal lines that may represent water. The scene is minimalistic with all elements outlined.

artworks.title: Two Men
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing the upper bodies of two individuals. The person on the right is seated and facing sideways with their head turned toward the viewer, allowing both their profile and partially their face to be seen. This person has wavy hair depicted in loose strokes, and facial features including eyes, a nose, and mouth are visible. On the left, another figure is sitting with their back and head turned away from the viewer; detailed features are not visible due to the angle. Both individuals appear to be clad in loose garments suggested through flowing lines. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, with the sketch drawn on textured paper, possibly stained or aged, that frames the figures.

artworks.title: Man Carrying a Sack
artworks.description: The image contains a sketch of a person with a blurred form. The individual appears to be carrying a large sack on their back, and is depicted in a slightly bent forward posture. The facial features, hair, clothing, jewelry, and objects are not distinguishable due to the abstract style of the drawing. The background is also abstract, with soft, blurry shading and indistinct shapes.

artworks.title: Charity
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person standing with a staff. The individual has a serene expression, long hair, and is wearing draped attire. The background features a rocky landscape, a tree, a column with figures, and an architectural building. Decorative engravings like a bird and an emblem are also present. Latin text is seen at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Patience
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a person standing upright, facing forward. The individual is holding a long staff with a flag in the right hand and pointing upward with the left hand. The person has wavy, mid-parted hair and is dressed in a flowing garment. In the upper left corner, there is a crest with a bird above a shield with a dog image. The background shows a cityscape near water. At the bottom, there is Latin text below the person. A rocky surface with the year "1552" and a monogram is on the left.

artworks.title: Chastity
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a draped female figure holding a staff in her right hand. Beside her is a decorative emblem or coat of arms that includes intricate details and a small sculpture on a pedestal. In the background, there are classical architectural elements including a column. The artist's monogram and the date "1552" are displayed on a tablet at the bottom right. A Latin inscription below the scene conveys a theme or concept, possibly reflecting on purity or virtue.

artworks.title: Temperance
artworks.description: The image shows a person holding a pole with a fish flag, surrounded by curls, wearing a classical garment, standing on rocky terrain with a sailboat in the background. A coat of arms and a Latin inscription are also included.

artworks.title: Compassion
artworks.description: The artwork shows a woman holding a child. The woman is standing, draped in flowing fabric. She has braided hair and holds a staff with a flag featuring an animal. The child is against her chest, with curly hair. There is a broken column on the left and a coat of arms with a lion, helmet, and goat on the right. The background is a flat surface with Latin text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Diligence
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical figure holding a staff with a bird perched on top. The scene features an elaborately dressed figure standing barefoot upon a textured ground. The figure holds a staff surmounted by a bird. To the right, there's a coat of arms featuring another bird and a squirrel. The lower part of the drawing contains Latin text. The date "1552" and a monogram are also present.

artworks.title: Hercules Killing Antaeus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in a struggle. One figure is hoisting the other onto their shoulders in an intense embrace. The scene is set against a rocky landscape with large boulders and cliffs. Sparse ground foliage and a tree with extended branches are also visible. The figures are detailed to highlight their musculature and the tension of their confrontation. The drawing captures a moment of decisive action in a dramatic and mythic setting.

artworks.title: Hercules Killing the Nemean Lion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a muscular figure fighting a lion. The background features classical architecture and trees with twisted branches, along with objects like a spear and shield against a tree trunk. The details in the drawing emphasize muscle tone and intricate patterns in the landscape and architecture.
